description:
Cast Artificial Evolution by paying {U}, changing all instances of "Bear" on Ayula to "Eldrazi".
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters the battlefield, Ayula triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Ayula triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 4.
